scope: read-only independent review; no GPU execution and no 3D modifications
source_priority: final_native.png only for scope and boundary review
required_before_truth_review: actual W-outside and K pixel exact checks
actual inverse-view including crop600 offset exact

visual_outputs.name: all_case_native_context
visual_outputs.layout: one case per sheet; seed rows, four arm columns
visual_outputs.crop: original native W bounding box plus fixed64px padding; same rectangle for all arms/seeds
visual_outputs.purpose: color continuity, false lane markings, large patches, perspective and boundary artifacts
visual_outputs.display: native pixels at common scale; no per-arm sharpening, tone fit or crop selection

visual_outputs.name: fixed_material_tiles
visual_outputs.layout: fixed original80x80 physical support; clean/reference or visible proxy, then all arms for both seeds
visual_outputs.selection: reuse frozen CPU masks/tiles and original centroid-nearest selection; never select from generated RGB
visual_outputs.display: nearest-neighbor only;192px panel gives integer6x and4x zoom respectively
visual_outputs.purpose: separate authentic-looking grain from false high frequency; retain native-pixel coordinate labels

visual_outputs.name: synthetic_color_and_structure
visual_outputs.layout: per-case paired points, seed101/202 both visible, four arm labels
measures: paint/false-line observations separate from safe-texture metrics
visual_outputs.aggregation: case macro only, also show both source-frame groups; no independent-n4 significance or best-seed selection

visual_outputs.name: spectral_quality
visual_outputs.layout: fixed physical frequency bands; per-case/seed labels
measures: HP RMS ratio with sigma in native pixels
PSD band power ratio using cycles/native pixel
HP pattern RMSE as phase-sensitive diagnostic
visual_outputs.common_band: compare only bands below every arm's native-unit Nyquist; out-of-band bins explicitly unavailable
visual_outputs.interpretation: ratio closer1 is descriptive spectral agreement, not sufficient proof of authentic material

visual_outputs.name: VAE_controls
visual_outputs.layout: raw legal observation view, VAE mode reconstruction, resampling-only reference at768/1152
visual_outputs.purpose: known-visible-region compression and color error; no hidden-road truth claim

promotion_policy: No automatic winner or default replacement. Record all regressions and uncertainty. Generated C/S remain generated provenance and gain no 3D high-frequency authorization.
